name: Swarm of Infesting Insects
section: Chapter 5, Denizens of the Mists, Swarms of Insects
sourceWitness: Published D&D Beyond content in a paginated 444-sheet digital export. The digital sheet count is distinct from the hardcover folio.
appearanceEvidence: Olive-green, segmented insect larvae with rust-red heads mingle with darker adults with translucent wings.
artworkSource: Local read-only copy of the publisher artwork, images/beasts/swarm-of-infesting-insects/rhw-1.webp
artworkNote: The published chapter illustration has larvae and winged adults in a tall room scene. Both variants share a new square specimen study with the creature features on plain parchment.
habitatEvidence: The shared Swarms of Insects chapter heading lists Coastal, Forest, Grassland, Swamp, and Urban. Treasure is None.
conditionRules: The attack imposes Poisoned immediately. A DC 11 Constitution save occurs after one hour if the same condition remains. On failure, the 1d6 result determines the effect.
